requested_outcome: A single simple administration studio controls supplier-backed and VII-owned content for every world plus magazine, header, hamburger and footer, with preview, publication, versions and rollback.
natural_destination: The authenticated VII administration system and the corresponding public VII routes.
authorization_boundary: Local repository implementation, tests, commit and branch push are allowed. Production deployment and production data mutation require an explicit release action and live verification.

lesson_bundle.reason: The correction is specifically about an incomplete administration product.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Require a capability and permission matrix, persisted save, reload, public reflection, audit and rollback.

lesson_bundle.reason: The requested controls span content, navigation, footer, URLs and site-wide presentation.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Require edit, validation, permission, preview, publication and recovery for each CMS module.

lesson_bundle.reason: The studio will introduce visible tabs, filters, editors and actions.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Inventory and exercise every visible control in default, loading, success and failure states.

lesson_bundle.reason: The user explicitly identified a broad family gap, not one isolated screen.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Map every requested world and global surface to evidence or a precise blocker.

lesson_bundle.reason: The request uses examples and 'etc.' to indicate a complete family.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Treat examples as an affected-family inventory, not as permission to implement only spa.
Require Heebo or approved sans-serif coverage on the complete private surface.

lesson_bundle.reason: All content worlds must share one operational pattern.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Require the same hierarchy and lifecycle across worlds, with documented field differences.

lesson_bundle.reason: Published content, magazine, navigation and footer affect discoverability and indexation.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Require managed metadata, slug and indexability fields where the content type is public and indexable.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Only spa is editable while suppliers, trails, magazine, header and footer remain hard-coded.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Build one canonical entity model with an explicit complete type inventory.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Every requested content family appears in the studio and can open an entity editor.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The editor changes a local form but the public page still renders supplier or static text.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Resolve published VII overrides in the server-rendered public data path.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: A published override survives reload and replaces the source text at its natural public route.

predicted_rejections.rejection: A supplier refresh overwrites editorial content written by VII.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Store provider source and VII editorial overlay separately with field-level precedence.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: A refreshed source snapshot changes the source view while the published VII override remains active.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The CMS looks powerful but has dead controls, no history or no safe recovery.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Implement optimistic concurrency, version snapshots, preview and rollback as real persisted actions.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Save, conflict, publish, reload and rollback tests pass and the UI explains the current state.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The system is comprehensive but confusing and slow to operate.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Use one current layer: choose content family, choose item, edit one focused panel, then preview or publish.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Desktop and mobile show one primary action and defer technical fields into secondary panels.

affected_family: Hebrew, English, Russian and French content variants
draft, review, scheduled, published and archived states
public page rendering and cache invalidation

sources.label: VII project architecture and verified current-truth boundary
VII accepted product and administration expectations

midpoint_gate.trigger: After a single spa entity completes source, override, save, reload, preview and publish before expanding the family.
checks: Provider source remains visible and immutable
VII override persists with a version
Published text resolves on the public spa route

attack_questions: Can a supplier refresh erase a VII-written description?
Can two editors silently overwrite each other?
Can an unauthorized user read or change draft content?
Does a rollback create a new audited version instead of deleting history?
Do header, hamburger and footer resolve from one canonical published model?
adversarial_close.natural_destination_evidence: Authenticated administration save and reload plus the exact public route rendering the published result.
adversarial_close.affected_family_evidence: Representative entity and global-surface tests across all listed content types, languages, lifecycle states and permission paths.

effectiveness.baseline: Current content is split across supplier payloads, static data files and specialized admin tools, with no single complete CMS family.
effectiveness.target: One reusable lifecycle replaces per-world hard-coded editing and prevents the previously reported missing-family correction.
